metas.name: ★ 8.5 · 2023 · Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
metas.description: Traveling across the multiverse, Miles Morales meets a new team of Spider-People, made up of heroes from different dimensions. But when the heroes clash over how to deal with a new threat, Miles finds himself at a crossroads.

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 2022 · Puss in Boots: The Last Wish
metas.description: When Puss in Boots discovers that his passion for adventure has taken its toll and he has burned through eight of his nine lives, he launches an epic journey to restore them by finding the mythical Last Wish.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2025 · KPop Demon Hunters
metas.description: A world-renowned K-Pop girl group balance their lives in the spotlight with their secret identities as demon hunters.

metas.name: ★ 8.3 · 2025 · Demon Slayer: Kimetsu No Yaiba Infinity Castle
metas.description: The Demon Slayer Corps are drawn into the Infinity Castle, where Tanjiro and the Hashira face terrifying Upper Rank Hindi mein demons in a desperate fight as the final battle against Muzan Kibutsuji begins.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2023 · Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Mutant Mayhem
metas.description: The Turtle brothers work to earn the love of New York City while facing down an army of mutants.

metas.name: ★ 8.3 · 2025 · Chainsaw Man - The Movie: Reze Arc
metas.description: A direct sequel to the first season of the series "Chainsaw Man", featuring Denji, a young man who co-exists with a chainsaw demon. Denji encounters a new romantic interest, but will his involvement place them both in danger?

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2024 · Transformers One
metas.description: The untold origin story of Optimus Prime and Megatron, better known as sworn enemies, but who once were friends bonded like brothers who changed the fate of Cybertron forever.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2022 · The Sea Beast
metas.description: When a young girl stows away on the ship of a legendary sea monster hunter, they launch an epic journey into uncharted waters - and make history to boot.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2023 · Nimona
metas.description: When a knight in a futuristic medieval world is framed for a crime he didn't commit, the only one who can help him prove his innocence is Nimona -- a mischievous teen who happens to be a shapeshifting creature he's sworn to destroy.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2025 · Predator: Killer of Killers
metas.description: Three of the fiercest warriors in human history become prey to the ultimate killer of killers.

metas.name: ★ 8.5 · 2025 · Mahavatar Narsimha
metas.description: The demon Hiranyakashyap seeks revenge on Vishnu and declares himself a god. His son Prahlad remains devoted to Vishnu. Vishnu manifests as Narsimha to defeat the demon and restore balance.

metas.name: ★ 8.9 · 2024 · Attack on Titan: The Last Attack
metas.description: The fate of the world hangs in the balance as Eren unleashes the ultimate power of the Titans. With a burning determination to eliminate all who threaten Eldia, he leads an unstoppable army of Colossal Titans towards Marley.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2025 · The Bad Guys 2
metas.description: The Bad Guys are struggling to find trust and acceptance in their newly minted lives as Good Guys, when they are pulled out of retirement and forced to do "one last job" by an all-female squad of criminals.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2026 · Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender
metas.description: Avatar Aang, the world's last Airbender, learns of an ancient power that could save his culture from extinction. With the help of his friends, he embarks on a global quest to find it before it falls into the wrong hands.

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 2025 · Ne Zha 2
metas.description: After a great catastrophe, the souls of Nezha and Aobing are saved, but their bodies face ruin. To give them new life, Taiyi Zhenren turns to the mystical seven-colored lotus in a daring bid to rebuild them and change their fate.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2023 · Invincible: Atom Eve
metas.description: In this special prequel episode, Samantha 'Atom Eve' Wilkins discovers her superpowers as a young girl - and must come to terms with her own sinister origins as she discovers a family she never knew she had.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2022 · Dragon Ball Super: Super Hero
metas.description: The Red Ribbon Army from Goku's past has returned with two new androids to challenge him and his friends.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2023 · Demon Slayer: Kimetsu No Yaiba - To the Swordsmith Village
metas.description: Tanjiro needs to bring a definitive end to Upper Rank Six. After the dust settles, he goes with his sister Nezuko to the Swordsmith Village in search of a new sword.

metas.name: ★ 8.7 · 2024 · Solo Leveling: ReAwakening
metas.description: Over a decade after 'gates' connecting worlds appeared, awakening 'hunters' with superpowers, weakest hunter Sung Jinwoo encounters a double dungeon and accepts a mysterious quest, becoming the only one able to level up, changing ...

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2023 · Mars Express
metas.description: Set in the 23rd century on Mars, the plot follows the investigation on a murder case carried out by the couple formed by private investigator Aline Ruby and her android companion Carlos Rivera.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2024 · Demon Slayer: Kimetsu No Yaiba - To the Hashira Training
metas.description: Tanjiro undergoes rigorous training with the Stone Hashira, Himejima, in his quest to become a Hashira. Meanwhile, Muzan continues to search for Nezuko and Ubuyashiki.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2023 · Black Clover: Sword of the Wizard King
metas.description: In a world where magic is everything, Asta, a boy who was born with no magic, aims to become the "Wizard King" to overcome adversity, prove his power, and keep his oath with his friends.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2023 · Spy x Family Code: White
metas.description: After receiving an order to be replaced in Operation Strix, Loid decides to help Anya win a cooking competition at Eden Academy, by making the director's favorite meal in order to prevent his replacement.
